title: First teacher Vigory and members of the Italian band
summary: They try to recall his first teacher's name and who else played in the Italian band, such as Manuel Alexander and Mario Fanazzi.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Yeah, let's see. I wanted to ask you some more if we can get back. Who was your first teacher?
I'm going to forget his name.
Vigory? Vigory, yeah. You don't remember his first name? No, I never did. I don't know if it was John.
I'm sure we can find it out one more time. I imagine Louis Panzeri will know, because he knows all the teachers. You know Louis.
That's the only name I remember. Yeah.
And what about the Italian band? Who else was in that? Tony Perrani and...
Oh, Manuel Alexander. You remember? Yeah, sure. Well... Do you remember...
Do you remember... Fanazzi? Mario Fanazzi? Yeah, yeah.
He was there then. He was there then. I know his son too. Well, uh...
The guys that played in that band... Tony Perrani and I was the only one that got to be known, you know, to go out of town. Yeah.
